items.raw_excerpt: Número oito do mundo, o mesatenista brasileiro derrotou na final o francês Alexis Lebun (11º) por 4 sets a 3, no torneio em São José dos Campos. Mais cedo, Calderano foi vice-campeão de duplas mistas ao lado de Bruna Takahashi.
items.summary_en: World number eight Calderano defeated France's Alexis Lebun in the final at São José dos Campos. He also reached the mixed doubles final with Bruna Takahashi.
items.summary_ko: 세계 8위 칼데라노가 São José dos Campos 대회 결승에서 프랑스의 Alexis Lebun을 세트 스코어 4-3으로 꺾고 우승했다. 그는 또한 Bruna Takahashi와 함께 혼합복식 결승에 올랐다.
items.title_en: Brazilian Table Tennis Player Wins WTT Star Contender Title

items.raw_excerpt: There are a total of 65 lakh beneficiaries in the Bescom jurisdiction, and 40 lakh households are yet to be verified.
items.summary_en: Server problems and a shortage of meter readers are delaying the verification process for the Gruha Jyothi electricity subsidy scheme. The program needs to verify 65 lakh beneficiaries in the Bescom area, but 40 lakh households are still waiting. Officials are working to resolve the technical and staffing problems.
items.summary_ko: 서버 문제와 검침원 부족으로 구루하 조티 전기 보조금 제도의 확인 작업이 지연되고 있다. 베스콤 관할 650만 수혜자 중 아직 400만 가구가 확인을 기다리고 있다. 관계 기관은 기술적 문제와 인력난 해결에 나섰다.
items.title_en: Server issues and staff shortage delay electricity subsidy verification in Karnataka
items.title_ko: 카르나타카주 전기 보조금 확인 작업에 서버 문제와 인력 부족으로 차질
items.title_original: Server issues, shortage of meter readers delay Gruha Jyothi verification in Karnataka

items.raw_excerpt: Gladys Bay won for her role as Bella in the Mediacorp Chinese drama, Under The Net.
items.summary_en: Mediacorp actress Gladys Bay received the Outstanding Asian Star award at the Seoul International Drama Awards 2026. She won the honor for her role as Bella in the Chinese drama Under The Net. The awards ceremony celebrates outstanding television performances from across Asia.
items.summary_ko: 메디아콤 배우 글래디스 베이가 2026년 서울 국제 드라마 시상식에서 아시아 스타상을 받았다. 그녀는 중국 드라마 'Under The Net'에서 벨라 역으로 출연해 이 상을 수상했다. 이 시상식은 아시아 각국의 뛰어난 텔레비전 작품을 기념하는 행사이다.
items.title_en: Singapore actress wins Outstanding Asian Star award at Seoul drama ceremony
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 배우, 서울 국제 드라마 시상식에서 아시아 스타상 수상
items.title_original: Mediacorp artiste Gladys Bay wins Outstanding Asian Star award for Singapore at Seoul International Drama Awards

items.raw_excerpt: A tropical depression, currently over 6,000 kilometers from Taiwan, could be upgraded to a tropical storm within 24 hours, but is unlikely to have a direct impact on the country, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Monday.
items.summary_en: A tropical depression over 6,000 km from Taiwan may become a tropical storm within 24 hours. The Central Weather Administration says it will not directly affect Taiwan.
items.summary_ko: 대만에서 6,000km 이상 떨어진 열대저기압이 24시간 내 열대폭풍으로 발전할 수 있다. 대만 기상청은 이 기압계가 대만에 직접 영향을 주지 않을 것이라고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Tropical depression far from Taiwan could strengthen but will not hit
items.title_ko: 대만에서 6,000km 떨어진 열대저기압, 폭풍으로 발전할 수 있지만 영향 없어
items.title_original: Tropical depression could become storm but no impact on Taiwan: CWA

items.raw_excerpt: NDMC cleans Jantar Mantar, removing 60 metric tonnes of waste post-protest, restoring the site for public use.
items.summary_en: Workers removed 60 metric tonnes of waste from Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. The cleanup followed a recent protest at the historic site. The area is now open to the public again.

items.raw_excerpt: A large sinkhole has opened up on a street in Auckland's St Mary's Bay.
items.summary_en: A large sinkhole has opened on a street in Auckland's St Mary's Bay. The road was previously damaged during the 2023 floods. The sinkhole poses risks to nearby homes and vehicles.

items.title_en: Sinkhole opens on Auckland street damaged in 2023 floods

items.raw_excerpt: Der Wien-Tourismus will zeigen, dass Wien auch nach den Feiertagen lebendig bleibt. Dazu wird im Januar 2026 das schottische Dorf “Dull”, dessen Name auf Englisch “fad” bedeutet, nach Wien eingeladen. Die rund 100 Einwohner wurden persönlich besucht, und 37 von ihnen nahmen die Einladung an, wie der Tourismusverband mitteilte.
items.summary_en: Vience tourism invited the small Scottish village named Dull to visit in January 2026. Staff personally visited about 100 villagers, and 37 of them accepted the fun invitation. The village name means boring in English.
items.summary_ko: 빈 관광청이 2026년 1월에 Dull이라는 이름의 작은 스코틀랜드 마을을 빈으로 초청했습니다. 관광청 직원들이 약 100명의 마을 사람들을 직접 만났고, 37명이 이 재미있는 제안을 받아들였습니다.
items.title_en: Vienna invites Scottish village called Dull for January visit
items.title_ko: 빈 관광청, 이름 '재미없을'이라는 스코틀랜드 마을을 1월에 초청
items.title_original: Wien-Tourismus lädt schottisches Dorf "Dull" im Jänner ein - vienna.at

items.raw_excerpt: This small town Michigan restaurant sells 80,000 BBQ-inspired egg rolls a year
items.summary_en: A restaurant in a small Michigan town has become famous for its BBQ-inspired egg rolls. The eatery sells about 80,000 of the unique rolls each year.
